---
title: "Florida"
---

## Florida's children, by census tract

Each shape represents a census tract. Darker colors indicate a larger share of
residents under age 18, based on the 2024 American Community Survey 5-year
estimates.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-dpi: 180

library(ggplot2)

tracts <- sf::st_read("state/florida_tracts_under18_2024.geojson", quiet = TRUE)

ggplot(tracts) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = percent_under_18), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    labels = \(x) paste0(round(x), "%"),
    name = "Residents under 18"
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "The share of children across Florida census tracts",
    subtitle = "Percent of residents under age 18 in each census tract",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 ACS 5-year estimates. Estimates are subject to sampling error."
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 21, color = "#18324b"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "#52677b"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "#52677b", hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#18324b"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#52677b"),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(2.5, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
  )
```
